_readme: Corpus metadata for ingest.mjs. `title` is what LightRAG stores as the
document's file_path, which is exactly what the app cites to the user — so
keep these titles clean and stable. Changing a title after ingest orphans
the old citations until that document is re-ingested.
Keys are paths relative to corpus/ (lectures live in corpus/lectures/).
Lookup also accepts the bare filename and the filename without .txt.
`year` is taken from each ebook's own 'First published in ...' front matter,
not inferred; omit it rather than guess. `kind` is 'book' or 'lecture'.
Files missing here still ingest — ingest.mjs derives a title from the
filename and warns so this file can be filled in.
